data.title: 爱夏·页边的术式修订
data.action: 左手食指对照书中图形，右手在笔记页边补上一笔
data.description: 爱夏侧坐在藏书室长桌旁，左手食指按着参考书中的术式图，右手在旁边的笔记页上补画一条连线。她微微前倾，视线落在笔尖；高领衬衫和绿色马甲清晰可辨。斜射午后日光横过两本打开的书，墨水瓶放在远离袖口的桌角，背景仅保留拱窗和书脊。
data.promptProse: At the library table, adult Aisha places her left index finger below a reference diagram while her right hand adds a connecting stroke to the neighboring notebook. Cream high-neck blouse, forest-green vest and charcoal skirt retain her scholar outfit. The three-quarter medium view includes both contact points and an inkpot beneath the tall window arch. Diagonal afternoon light crosses the pages and intent eyes, with book-edge shadows separating the two volumes.
